intro: I turn complex problems into simple digital experiences. From the first pixel to products used by thousands of people.
aboutTitle:
BUILDING INTERFACES.
CONNECTING PEOPLE.
SHIPPING PRODUCTS.
aboutText: I’m Gabriel, a full stack developer specializing in front-end and mobile. For over 6 years, I’ve connected engineering, design and product thinking to turn ideas into fast, accessible and reliable applications.
aboutMore: From iFood’s delivery ecosystem to Emanu, the startup I co-founded, my work extends from interfaces to architecture, testing, API integration and the details that make an experience feel right.
projectNote: A selection of web and mobile projects. Explore the details or visit the website and app listing.
school: Centro Universitário União das Américas Descomplica
contactText: Great products start with a good conversation. I’m open to front-end, mobile and full stack challenges with teams that care about the experience.
footer: Made with intention. Built with code.

metadata.title: Gabriel Lennon — Full Stack, Front-end & Mobile
metadata.description: Full stack developer specializing in React, Next.js and React Native. Over 6 years building digital products. Former iFood and Doji engineer, and Emanu co-founder.
metadata.ogDescription: Full stack engineering. Front-end & mobile expertise.

emanu.name: EMANU
emanu.title: From an idea to 150k+ downloads.
emanu.description: A faith and spiritual growth platform with personalized experiences, subscriptions and AI.
emanu.detail: As co-founder and CTO, I built the web platform and mobile app with React, Next.js, React Native and Node.js. I designed and launched the premium subscription journey and integrated AI features to support users in their spiritual growth.

doji.name: DOJI TRADE-IN
doji.title: Complex under the hood. Simple on screen.
doji.description: Device grading with condition-assessment rules and real-time pricing.
doji.detail: I developed the Next.js Grading system for Doji’s trade-in ecosystem. The interface translates complex condition-assessment rules into a clear workflow connected to real-time pricing and the device resale lifecycle.

device.name: DEVICE DIAGNOSTICS
device.title: Reliability in the palm of your hand.
device.description: A mobile app running automated functional tests to check device integrity.
device.detail: I developed a React Native app to run automated functional tests on mobile devices. I connected web and mobile workflows to maintain consistent data and support reverse logistics throughout the trade-in process.

ifood.name: DELIVERY INTELLIGENCE
ifood.title: Better decisions. Smarter deliveries.
ifood.description: An application for courier assignment, distance calculations and delivery estimates.
ifood.detail: At iFood, I built a React and TypeScript application for delivery parameters: courier selection, restaurant-to-customer distance and estimated delivery times. I wrote tests with Jest, React Testing Library and Cypress and built accessible interfaces with SASS and Styled Components.

hurb.name: TRAVEL EXPERIENCE
hurb.title: The journey starts with the experience.
hurb.description: Travel service pages connecting people with insurance, currency exchange and connectivity.
hurb.detail: At Hurb, I built Next.js pages presenting travel services and helping users discover complementary products such as insurance, currency exchange and international SIM cards, using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and SASS.

lexos.name: COMMERCE OPERATIONS
lexos.title: Many marketplaces. One operation.
lexos.description: Tools to manage sales and listings across major marketplaces.
lexos.detail: At Lexos, I developed Angular and Vue.js features for a platform managing sales and listings on Mercado Livre, Shopee, AliExpress and Magalu. I integrated APIs and wrote unit tests with Karma and Jasmine.

vendergas.name: VENDER GÁS
vendergas.title: Sales management for gas retailers.
vendergas.description: A web platform for commercial operations at cooking-gas retailers.
vendergas.detail: Sales management and day-to-day operations for cooking-gas retailers, bringing their commercial workflows into a web experience.

smart-performance.name: SMARTPERFORMANCE
smart-performance.title: Interfaces for commercial operations.
smart-performance.description: Web applications for sales management and business operations.
smart-performance.detail: Front-end development with Angular, UI/UX prototyping in Figma and coordination of front-end activities, as part of my experience at SmartPerformance.

wiz.name: WIZ SEGUROS
wiz.title: Web experiences for services.
wiz.description: Web applications, service management and API integration.
wiz.detail: Front-end development with Angular and React, API integration and unit testing with Karma and Jasmine, as part of my experience at Wiz.

beerpass.name: BEERPASS
beerpass.title: The club experience, on mobile.
beerpass.description: A mobile experience for the BeerPass club.
beerpass.detail: BeerPass Club brings its club experience to mobile. The preview shows screens from the app; the link opens its App Store listing.

dayworktools.name: DAY WORK TOOLS
dayworktools.title: Everyday tools, together.
dayworktools.description: A productivity hub with a to-do list, notes and focus tools.
dayworktools.detail: Day Work Tools brings everyday productivity tools into one web experience, including a to-do list, a notepad and activities in focus.

seven.name: SEVEN GLOBAL
seven.title: A window to international experiences.
seven.description: An institutional website presenting international education experiences.
seven.detail: Seven Global presents its international education programs through a web experience that introduces the organization and its programs.

lalale.name: LALALE FOODS
lalale.title: Food, events and brand presence.
lalale.description: An institutional website for Lalale Group and its food services.
lalale.detail: The Lalale Group website presents the group and its food, events and food producer services in a shared digital presence.

emanu.description: From MVP to a platform with 150k+ downloads. Web, mobile, subscriptions and AI.

doji.description: A trade-in ecosystem spanning device grading, pricing and automated diagnostics.

ifood.description: Delivery operations interfaces focused on accessibility, testing and reliability.

gama.description: Teaching front-end fundamentals, modern tools, testing and accessibility.

hurb.description: Web experiences for discovering travel services and complementary products.

wiz.description: Security service hiring and management applications with API integration and testing.

lexos.description: Sales and listing management integrated with major marketplaces.

smart-performance.description: Leading the front-end team, introducing agile practices and prototyping UI/UX.

bilin.description: Sales management systems, API integration, prototyping and customer support.

fnde.description: A web application distributing education news to Brazilian schools.
